name: Playa de Binimel·la
description: A broad beach of reddish sand with an islet and red clay (a popular spot for mud baths). The classic starting point for the walk to Cala Pregonda; reachable by car, which makes it an easy way into the wild north.

highlights: the reddish sand and the mud baths from the clay
the classic starting point for the walk to Cala Pregonda
easy access by car and parking by the beach

imageAlt: Binimel·là beach with its lagoon behind and the low scrub of the north coast
imageCredit: carlos venegas gavilán / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)

practicalInfo.aparcamiento: Capacity-controlled (2026 season): the gravel car park closes when full. It is the gateway to the island's red north, so in August it fills during the morning. There is no point looking for a spot nearby: the lanes are narrow and parking on them is not allowed.
practicalInfo.mejorEpoca: May, June and September. Bear in mind that the walk to Pregonda also starts here, so the car park absorbs two beaches at once. Access control runs from 7.30am to 9pm and stays in place until 15 October.
